correctness.rationale: For J²=-I, the predictor–corrector update is [(1-η²XY)I−ηYJ]z. Its transpose times itself is exactly [(1-uXY)²+uY²]I. With iid outer pairs this gives the exact all-iterations power identity. The joint two-point marginal law has one free t and its mixed moments are M2−t(b−a)² and M4−t(b²−a²)², making ρ affine in t, with derivative u(b−a)²[2−u(a+b)²]. Positivity E[X²Y²]>0 gives the necessary/sufficient strict stability interval and neutral boundary. Recomputed the sample a=1,b=2,p=1/2,u=1/3 yielding 10/9,37/36,17/18 and ceilings 5/17,8/25,3/8. Strict endpoint cases and equal-marginal constraint are explicit.
